SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_inc_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  period_start_date,
  period_end_date,
  weeks_in_period
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS web_orders,
  COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS web_lines,
  MIN(f.sale_date) AS first_sale_date,
  MAX(f.sale_date) AS last_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
